name: Divider
summary: Line that separates content, optionally with a label in the middle ("or").
use: Between groups that spacing alone does not separate clearly enough.
Between alternative options, with the label "or".
avoid: When spacing already separates enough. Try space first.
a11y: Without a label: role="separator". Purely decorative lines can be aria-hidden.
dont: A divider under every row of a list.
